description: Retrieve one concrete indexed chunk by uid, or by documentId plus chunkIndex. Optionally returns adjacent chunks from the same document for context.

contextAfter.description: Number of following chunks to include. Defaults to 0.

contextBefore.description: Number of previous chunks to include. Defaults to 0.

documentId.description: Document id. Required when looking up by chunkIndex.

uid.description: Exact Azure Search uid for the chunk.

userLocation.description: Optional approximate user location. Include only if the client or user has explicitly made it available; do not infer or guess it.

country.description: ISO country code when available, for example ES.

timezone.description: IANA timezone when available, for example Europe/Madrid.

name: get_chunk
title: Get Chunk
